correctness.rationale: For every k>=2, each factor of length kn in the fixed point of 0 -> 0^(k-1)1, 1 -> 0^k is a rotation by r<k of phi_k(u) for a length-n factor u, because each image block has k-1 leading zeros. All nonempty one markers in phi_k(u) have indices congruent k-1 mod k. Every input factor n>=2 contains zero since the fixed point avoids 11, so rotating images of two such factors to coincide forces a multiple-of-k shift, hence conjugacy of source factors. Different residues give k|C| target members and Parikh complement t -> n-t; handle two singleton classes at n=1 separately. Independent direct factor-set/class enumeration matched k=2..4, n=1..7 including class sizes.
